Corollary
[Topology of small metric balls] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0432 1. appG:G.59\group Aleksandrov structure For every point $p$ of a compact Aleksandrov space as in Theorem 2, some metric ball $B(p,\epsilon )$ is homeomorphic to the tangent cone $T_pX$.
